commands.quality_gate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
commands.quality_gate_strict: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npx tsc --noEmit

test.heading: ### TypeScript Testing
test.content:
Run all tests:
```bash
npm test
```

Run with coverage:
```bash
npm run test:cov
```

Run specific test file:
```bash
npm test -- src/path/to/test.spec.ts
```

Run in watch mode:
```bash
npm test -- --watch
```

Run with debugger:
```bash
npm test -- --inspect-brk
```

build.heading: ### TypeScript Building
build.content:
Build all:
```bash
npm run build
```

Build with watch mode:
```bash
npm run build:watch
```

Build specific target:
```bash
npx tsc --project tsconfig.app.json
```

Check types without emitting:
```bash
npx tsc --noEmit
```

Clean build artifacts:
```bash
npm run clean
```

quality-gate.heading: ### TypeScript Quality Gates
quality-gate.content:
Run all quality checks:
```bash
npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
```

Format check:
```bash
npm run format:check
```

Lint with ESLint:
```bash
npm run lint
```

Type checking:
```bash
npx tsc --noEmit
```
